Dear ,
Congratulations on accepting our offer of employment for the position of in the at !

To complete your official onboarding and employee registration, please reply to this email immediately with the following six (6) mandatory documents attached, or click the link below to upload them online:

div.style: background-color: #f8f9fa; border-left: 4px solid #004085; padding: 15px; margin: 20px 0; border-radius: 4px;

ol.li: Picture (1): Recent passport-size photograph with white/blue background (will be used for your employee identification card and official profile).
CNIC (1): Scanned copy of Computerized National Identity Card (both front and back sides).
Resignation Acceptance Letter: Resignation acceptance / clearance / relieving letter from your current or most recent employer.
Educational Documents: Complete educational credentials (Degrees, Transcripts, Certificates: Matriculation, Intermediate, Graduation, Post-Graduation).
Certification Documents: Professional or technical certifications (e.g. PEC Certificate, Cisco, Microsoft, PMP, ITIL, etc.).
